task: The Lattice framework has no hard circuit breaker on story-lifecycle churn, so a non-converging story can advance, re-review, and take over its own owner-lease indefinitely and burn unattended compute for hours (B-f458 burned ~14 hours). Add a graduated breaker that stops the runaway without blocking healthy autonomous work.
outcome:
When a runaway story trips the breaker, the operator sees this in the terminal instead of a silent 15th re-review.

FIRST TRIP (auto-recovery, no human needed) — the framework brakes the loop once and continues:
  $ lattice story_advance {"storyId":"B-9xyz","phase":"REVIEW"}
  ⚠ CONVERGENCE BREAKER (auto-recovered 1/1): story B-9xyz shows a non-converging signature
      tripped: advance-count 21 > 20
      auto-recovery budget spent: the window baseline was reset once; if this recurs the story will FREEZE.
      authoritative next action: lattice done_prepare --storyId=B-9xyz --dryRun   (shows the real blocking gate)
  Story B-9xyz advanced to REVIEW

RE-TRIP (freeze, human ack required) — one automated recovery already failed, so the framework stops:
  $ lattice story_advance {"storyId":"B-9xyz","phase":"REVIEW"}
  ✗ CONVERGENCE BREAKER: story B-9xyz is FROZEN (auto-recovery already spent)
      tripped: advance-count 26 > 20 ; review pass-rate 4/40 = 10% < 35% (min-sample 10) ; takeover-frequency 7 in 60m > 5
      this story cycled without converging; the framework will not advance it again unattended.
      authoritative next action: lattice done_prepare --storyId=B-9xyz --dryRun
      a human must review and explicitly resume:
        lattice story_resume --storyId=B-9xyz --ack --reason="<why it is safe to continue>"
  gate: BLOCKED (blockedBy=convergence_breaker_frozen)

AUTOPILOT CANNOT SELF-ACK — the resume command refuses when no human is in the loop:
  $ LATTICE_AUTOPILOT=1 lattice story_resume --storyId=B-9xyz --ack --reason="retry"
  ✗ story_resume refused: convergence-breaker ack requires an interactive human session (autopilot/non-interactive detected). A human must clear the freeze.

HEALTHY STORIES ARE UNAFFECTED — a normal story (6-10 advances, converging) never prints any breaker line; story_advance behaves exactly as before.
facts: B-f458 forensics (proofbound/tmp/bf458-forensics-2026-07-14/, activity.jsonl 926 events, 08:20Z-22:36Z): 89 story_advance (41x DEV->REVIEW + 39x REVIEW->DEV ping-pong); a healthy lifecycle needs 6-10 advances.
Review churn: 131 review_run_start vs 31 review_pass_set = 23.7% overall pass-rate; the post-14Z (16:00 local) 8-hour window was 42 run_start / 4 pass = ~9.5% (INIT-003 corrected numbers).
Lease contention: 65 story-owner-lease-takeover events + 238 takeover/forceTakeover-flagged commands; three concurrent threads at 09:17Z fought the owner lease, staling each other's material.

Existing signals are advisory-only: core/review-convergence.ts is documented to NEVER block a transition; core/anti-stall.ts only renders retry/fix/discard text; core/usage-burn-alert.ts watches host-session token burn (a different axis) and is advisory:true.
core/story-owner-lease.ts enforces single-owner at a point in time (30-min staleness, forceTakeover as human override) but never counts takeover FREQUENCY, so all 65 overrides passed individually.

story.events already records advance transitions and (via activity) review_run_start / review_pass_set / lease-takeover, so counters are derivable read-only (same approach core/review-convergence.ts already uses via resolveReviewRoundCount).
constraints: MUST NOT block healthy autonomous development: a converging 6-10-advance story must never trip; the user explicitly rejected human-ack-on-every-freeze.
Counters derived read-only from story.events/activity; no new event-emission coupling in the hot path.
Graduated: first pathological trip auto-recovers exactly once (re-baseline window, no human); only a re-trip freezes and requires a human ack.
The resume/ack command MUST refuse under autopilot / non-interactive mode so a looping agent cannot self-ack.
Thresholds env-tunable module constants mirroring the B-623a BURN_ALERT_ENV resolver (typo-safe fallback, per-variable sanity ceilings).
Freeze state is a gitignored runtime artifact (registry + .gitignore) so it never dirties the DONE merge (story-owner-lease.ts F-008 pattern).
Do NOT weaken the single legitimate forceTakeover human-override path; exclude the milestone_ledger_set hint and review_pass_set writer-identity gaps (owned by concurrent work).
unknowns: Exact enforcement insertion point: does the story_advance command handler in cli-engine.ts have a single pre-transition seam, and do takeover-carrying commands route through the same seam?
How is autopilot / non-interactive mode detected (LATTICE_AUTOPILOT env? a TTY check? an existing helper)? The ack refusal depends on it.
Windowing basis for takeover-frequency and pass-rate: wall-clock minutes vs a trailing count of events — which is already available cheaply from story.events?

Is the repeated-identical-gate-failure signal (INIT-002: same gate + same reason twice) derivable read-only from recorded events, or are gate rejections not persisted as events? If not derivable, that signal is scoped down and documented rather than faked.
Where breaker state should live so it is visible to both the advance handler and the resume command without a race with the owner lease.
touchpoints: packages/main/src/core/convergence-breaker.ts (new pure core: signal derivation + assessBreaker decision fn)
packages/main/src/cli-engine.ts (story_advance / takeover-command pre-transition breaker check + rejection render)
packages/main/src/core/review-convergence.ts + core/story-owner-lease.ts (event-scan + rejection-gate patterns to reuse, not reimplement)
